recentItems.title: SpaceX Starship: Has Elon Musk's biggest gamble just paid off? | DW News
recentItems.description:
Elon Musk's Starship megarocket has reached orbit for the first time after blasting off from Texas. The test flight is also deploying next-generation Starlink satellites. The 124-meter rocket was designed to be fully reusable to lower launch costs. SpaceX is hoping to develop the gigantic launch vehicle for future trips to the Moon and Mars. We speak to Jeff Foust, senior writer at SpaceNews.com about Starship's milestone.

recentItems.title: UK police investigate suspected terror plot at British airbase used by the US | DW News
recentItems.description:
A farmer spots masked men near RAF Fairford in southern England. Five men are arrested, a village is evacuated and one of the most important military airbases used by the US in Europe finds itself at the center of a major counterterrorism investigation. 
DW correspondent Birgit Maass reports from Fairford airbase, where investigators are still trying to determine what exactly happened and who was behind it.
